name: ActARion FAQ - AR SOP Platform Questions
description: Frequently asked questions about ActARion's AR platform for SOPs, including hardware compatibility, system integrations, proof of concept, implementation, ROI, and modules.

acceptedAnswer.text: We believe frontline (blue-collar) workers deserve the same level of innovation as office-based teams. By equipping them with the right tools, we boost productivity, improve safety, and turn procedures into real-world performance.

We transform text-heavy SOPs into visual, interactive workflows. Create no-code 3D/AR instructions, deploy to mobile, tablet and smart glasses, integrate live remote support, capture feedback and performance data, and centrally manage knowledge across locations.
An AR platform for industrial companies (manufacturing, field service, logistics, utilities) enabling on-the-job training, real-time guidance, and scalable knowledge capture.

mainEntity.name: Which hardware is compatible with ActARion?

acceptedAnswer.text: Microsoft HoloLens 2, Apple Vision Pro, iOS and Android smartphones/tablets, and rugged industrial devices.
We partner with certified suppliers to recommend and bundle the right devices. Purchase and leasing arrangements can be included.

mainEntity.name: Can ActARion integrate with our systems?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We begin with a PoC to validate data flows, and offer APIs and custom integrations for ERP (e.g., SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365), MES, LMS, and HR/quality systems.

mainEntity.name: What data can ActARion collect and analyze?

acceptedAnswer.text: Time-on-task and step duration, multiple-choice responses, user photos/videos, and digital checklists and numeric entries.
Basic API access is included. Complex integrations may require additional implementation support.

mainEntity.name: What is included in a Proof of Concept (PoC)?

acceptedAnswer.text: Scope target processes and workforce; baseline performance and waste; estimate improvement; define stakeholders and tech; evaluate outcomes to implement, iterate, or stop.
We teach clients to own their digital guidance. Rollouts take ~2–6 months with a dedicated account manager and optional industry-specific implementation partners.
Yes. We collaborate with system integrators, training consultants, and solution providers across Europe. Our partner program includes training, co-selling, and integration support.

mainEntity.name: What support is offered after launch?

acceptedAnswer.text: Helpdesk with SLAs, feature updates every 3 weeks, and customer success reviews and feedback cycles.

mainEntity.name: What value can ActARion bring and what ROI can we expect?

acceptedAnswer.text: Typical benefits: 50–75% faster onboarding, 80%+ fewer errors, reduced training costs, and improved compliance. Many clients see ROI in 6–12 months.

mainEntity.name: How do we build the business case?

acceptedAnswer.text: During prospecting and validated at PoC end, we quantify gains across onboarding time, SOP error rates, downtime, training cost, and expert dependency.

mainEntity.name: How does ActARion address workforce turnover and aging?

acceptedAnswer.text: We preserve expert knowledge digitally and make it instantly accessible to new hires—closing experience gaps and reducing operational risk.
Capture (expert knowledge), Studio (no-code 3D authoring), Holo Guidance (hands-free execution), Connect & Assistance (remote support), and Management Dashboard (skills & compliance).
Expert knowledge preservation via smart glasses to record the actions and instructions of experienced workers in real time, automatically generating documented procedures.

Hands-free viewing and data capture on smart glasses and mobile devices for on-the-go execution.
